summary: This is a Form 424B5 prospectus supplement filed by RedCloud Holdings plc relating to an at-the-market offering of ordinary shares up to $6.7M. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender or other special situation is present; it is a routine capital-raising shelf take-down. The filing describes the Sales Agreement with H.C. Wainwright & Co., LLC as sales agent with 3.0% commission, no minimum sale requirement, and no escrow arrangement. The filing is an ordinary securities offering, not a special situation.
